items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: Everybody in that group was very cognizant... Gordon always equated it with a football team... this guy’s going out for a pass... So Eric and Cornell never got in each other’s way... Same thing with Steve and I... when we were playing as a unit everybody was very respectful of the other guy’s turf.

ctx.x: And you could say the same thing about the two guitarists. How can a group with two guitar players and two drummers and a bassist and multi-keyboardist not be busy? And well the proof was in the records I guess.

Yeah. Everybody in that group was very cognizant — to borrow your word — of what the other guy was playing and nobody was like suppressing their ego especially but everyone wanted — Gordon always equated it with a football team. You know everybody’s got a job to do, you’re the safety, you’re the center, he was the quarterback of course but this guy’s going out for a pass, this guy’s going to do blocking, this guy’s going to do a Hail Mary, all the football analogies really worked because that’s how the band…
Although each guy, you know, got solos. Same thing with Steve and I, we each got drum solos but when we were playing as a unit everybody was very respectful of the other guy’s turf. I’m sorry —
